name: The Fool
upright: A new beginning, full of potential and freedom. Take the leap with an open heart.
reversed: Hesitation, recklessness, or a fear of starting. Weigh your impulses before leaping.
general: The Fool marks the start of a journey — a step into the unknown trusting that the path will unfold.

name: The Magician
upright: You have all the tools you need. Focus your will and turn intention into reality.
reversed: Untapped talent, scattered energy, or manipulation. Reconnect with your own power.
general: The Magician signals that your potential is within reach — align your talents and take deliberate action.

name: The High Priestess
upright: Trust your inner voice. The answers you seek come from quiet reflection, not noise.
reversed: Ignoring intuition, secrets surfacing, or being out of touch with your inner self.
general: The High Priestess invites you to listen beneath the surface — intuition knows what logic cannot yet explain.

name: The Empress
upright: Fertile ground for creation. Nurture yourself and let ideas, love, and life bloom.
reversed: Creative block, over-caring, or neglect of your own needs. Tend your own garden first.
general: The Empress represents nurturing abundance — a time to grow, create, and care for what matters.

name: The Emperor
upright: Establish order and take command. Discipline and clear boundaries create lasting structure.
reversed: Rigidity, domination, or a lack of control. Lead with wisdom, not force.
general: The Emperor stands for structure and authority — a time for rules, order, and taking responsibility.

name: The Hierophant
upright: Follow time-tested wisdom or seek guidance from mentors and established systems.
reversed: Rebellion against convention, unconventional choices, or challenging old beliefs.
general: The Hierophant connects you to tradition and shared wisdom — respect the teachings that guide you.

name: The Lovers
upright: A deep bond or a meaningful choice. Align your values with your actions and heart.
reversed: Imbalance, disharmony, or a difficult decision. Revisit what truly aligns with you.
general: The Lovers speaks of connection and values — significant choices made with love and integrity.

name: The Chariot
upright: Move forward with confidence and self-discipline. Steer opposing forces toward your goal.
reversed: Loss of direction, lack of momentum, or being pulled in too many directions.
general: The Chariot is triumphant momentum — harness willpower and focus to cross the finish line.

name: Strength
upright: True strength is quiet and gentle. Meet challenges with patience, courage, and grace.
reversed: Self-doubt, impatience, or losing your cool. Reclaim your inner calm.
general: Strength is the power of the gentle heart — courage shown through compassion rather than force.

name: The Hermit
upright: Step back and go within. Solitude brings clarity, and your own light guides the way.
reversed: Isolation, withdrawal, or stubborn loneliness. Reconnect with others when ready.
general: The Hermit withdraws to find truth — a time for reflection and inner guidance.

name: Wheel of Fortune
upright: The wheel turns in your favor. Embrace change; fortune favors the open-minded.
reversed: Resistance to change, bad timing, or cycles repeating. Flow with the spin.
general: Wheel of Fortune marks a turning point — life moves in cycles, and this turn carries new opportunity.

name: Justice
upright: Actions have consequences. Seek truth, weigh options, and make decisions with fairness.
reversed: Unfairness, dishonesty, or avoidance of accountability. Restore balance honestly.
general: Justice calls for truth and balance — every choice brings a result that must be faced.

name: The Hanged Man
upright: Pause and see from a new angle. Surrendering control may be the wiser path.
reversed: Stagnation, delay, or resisting a necessary sacrifice. Shift your viewpoint.
general: The Hanged Man suspends action to gain perspective — a sacred pause before renewal.

name: Death
upright: One chapter closes so another can begin. Release what no longer serves you.
reversed: Holding on, fear of change, or resistance to necessary endings.
general: Death rarely means physical end — it is transformation, clearing space for renewal.

name: Temperance
upright: Blend opposing forces into harmony. Patience and moderation bring healing.
reversed: Imbalance, excess, or disharmony. Restore steadiness and self-restraint.
general: Temperance is the golden mean — a measured blending of elements into peace.

name: The Devil
upright: Acknowledge what binds you. Awareness of a trap is the first step to freedom.
reversed: Breaking free, releasing unhealthy attachments, and reclaiming independence.
general: The Devil reveals the chains we choose — power, habit, or fear. Name them to break them.

name: The Tower
upright: Sudden change shatters false structures. Out of the ruins comes clarity.
reversed: Avoiding collapse, inner turmoil, or fear of inevitable change.
general: The Tower strikes down what was built on illusion — dramatic, liberating truth.

name: The Star
upright: After the storm, hope returns. Trust the universe and let your light shine.
reversed: Doubt, discouragement, or a lack of faith in the future. Rekindle hope.
general: The Star is a guiding light — healing, inspiration, and quiet confidence in what is to come.

name: The Moon
upright: Things are not as they seem. Trust your instincts through the fog.
reversed: Illusions fading, clarity emerging, or facing fears that held you back.
general: The Moon casts shadows and illusions — navigate uncertainty with intuition, not panic.

name: The Sun
upright: Bright success and radiant joy. Celebrate — everything is coming into the light.
reversed: Dimmed optimism, small setbacks, or a temporary cloud. The sun still shines.
general: The Sun brings warmth, clarity, and vitality — a time of visible happiness and success.

name: Judgement
upright: A call to rise. Reflect, forgive, and answer the summons to your true purpose.
reversed: Self-criticism, ignoring the call, or avoiding needed reflection.
general: Judgement is the great awakening — a summing-up that leads to rebirth and purpose.

name: The World
upright: A cycle completes and wholeness is reached. Celebrate achievement and begin anew.
reversed: Incomplete goals, loose ends, or reluctance to finish what was started.
general: The World crowns the journey — completion, fulfillment, and the start of the next circle.

name: Ace of Wands
upright: A spark of inspiration and creative energy. A new venture takes root.
reversed: Creative block, delayed plans, or passion fizzling out.
general: The Ace of Wands ignites enthusiasm — a potent seed of new energy and action.

name: Two of Wands
upright: You hold the world in your hands. Make a plan and step beyond your comfort zone.
reversed: Fear of the unknown, poor planning, or hesitation at the crossroads.
general: Two of Wands is the horizon-gazer — planning the next move toward a bigger life.

name: Three of Wands
upright: Your efforts begin to pay off. Watch for the opportunity on the horizon.
reversed: Delayed results, waiting, or plans that lack follow-through.
general: Three of Wands signals that growth is underway — broaden your view and prepare to receive.

name: Four of Wands
upright: A joyful milestone. Home, stability, and community come together in celebration.
reversed: Instability at home, postponed celebrations, or disharmony among loved ones.
general: Four of Wands is a festive archway — achievement, belonging, and the comfort of home.

name: Five of Wands
upright: Healthy rivalry and energetic debate. Struggle can sharpen your skills.
reversed: Avoiding conflict, petty squabbles, or exhausted by infighting.
general: Five of Wands is playful combat — competing ideas that can forge strength if kept constructive.

name: Six of Wands
upright: You are seen and celebrated. Victory is earned — receive the recognition graciously.
reversed: Failure, lack of recognition, or ego inflated by praise.
general: Six of Wands is the triumphant parade — success acknowledged by others.

name: Seven of Wands
upright: Hold your position. Others may challenge you — stand firm in your truth.
reversed: Feeling overwhelmed, giving up ground, or over-defensiveness.
general: Seven of Wands is the defender on the hill — asserting your place against the odds.

name: Eight of Wands
upright: Things move fast. Expect swift progress, sudden news, or things falling into place.
reversed: Delays, missed opportunities, or rushed and scattered energy.
general: Eight of Wands is flying action — rapid movement and quick communication.

name: Nine of Wands
upright: Almost there — draw on your reserves. The final stretch requires resilience.
reversed: Exhaustion, defensiveness, or giving up near the finish line.
general: Nine of Wands is the battle-worn survivor — resilience born from hard-won experience.

name: Ten of Wands
upright: Carrying too much. The burden is heavy, but the finish line is near — delegate.
reversed: Setting down burdens, burnout, or refusing help when needed.
general: Ten of Wands staggers under responsibility — recognize the load and lighten it.

name: Page of Wands
upright: A spark of youthful energy and curiosity. Exciting news or a creative idea arrives.
reversed: Disconnected energy, scattered focus, or enthusiasm that fizzles.
general: Page of Wands is the eager explorer — enthusiasm for what is new and unknown.

name: Knight of Wands
upright: Charging ahead with bold energy. Chase the adventure, but mind the speed.
reversed: Rashness, impatience, or flitting between projects without follow-through.
general: Knight of Wands gallops toward adventure — dynamic, fiery, and restless for action.

name: Queen of Wands
upright: Magnetic and self-assured. Lead with warmth, creativity, and bold confidence.
reversed: Insecurity, jealousy, or using charm to mask self-doubt.
general: Queen of Wands radiates confidence and warmth — a natural, inspiring leader.

name: King of Wands
upright: A visionary leader with fire and clarity. Take charge and inspire others.
reversed: Impulsiveness, domineering energy, or vision without follow-through.
general: King of Wands is the charismatic leader — turning bold vision into action.

name: Ace of Cups
upright: Love and emotion overflow. A new feeling, connection, or compassion blooms.
reversed: Emotional blockage, suppressed feelings, or fear of vulnerability.
general: Ace of Cups opens the heart — a fresh wellspring of emotion and connection.

name: Two of Cups
upright: A meaningful bond or partnership built on mutual care and understanding.
reversed: Imbalance in a relationship, broken trust, or misalignment of hearts.
general: Two of Cups is the meeting of souls — connection, cooperation, and loving exchange.

name: Three of Cups
upright: Joy shared with friends and community. Celebrate togetherness and milestones.
reversed: Isolation, social drama, or celebrating alone.
general: Three of Cups raises a glass with friends — fellowship, celebration, and shared joy.

name: Four of Cups
upright: Dissatisfaction amid abundance. Look up — an offer you overlook may be the answer.
reversed: Re-engagement, moving past apathy, or acceptance of what is offered.
general: Four of Cups sits in quiet discontent — a nudge to notice what is already offered.

name: Five of Cups
upright: Grief is real, but two cups still stand. Turn to what remains, not what spilled.
reversed: Acceptance, moving on, or forgiving yourself for past sorrow.
general: Five of Cups mourns the spilled cups — acknowledge loss, then turn toward what remains.

name: Six of Cups
upright: Sweet memories and innocence. A gift from the past or a reunion with someone dear.
reversed: Living in the past, nostalgia that binds, or unresolved childhood patterns.
general: Six of Cups returns to childhood warmth — nostalgia and the healing of old bonds.

name: Seven of Cups
upright: Many dreams, many choices. Ground your vision — not every cup holds what it seems.
reversed: Clarity, focus, or making a grounded decision after confusion.
general: Seven of Cups floats on imagination — beware illusion and choose with clarity.

name: Eight of Cups
upright: Walk away from what no longer fulfills you. The search for deeper meaning calls.
reversed: Hesitation to leave, lingering in comfort, or returning to an old situation.
general: Eight of Cups leaves fulfillment behind to seek more — a deliberate and brave departure.

name: Nine of Cups
upright: Your wish comes true. Relish satisfaction, gratitude, and emotional abundance.
reversed: Smugness, overindulgence, or a wish that leaves you empty.
general: Nine of Cups is the wish card — contentment, satisfaction, and heartfelt fulfillment.

name: Ten of Cups
upright: Emotional fulfillment and family harmony. Love shared radiates through your life.
reversed: Dysfunction, fractured bonds, or ideals that outpace reality.
general: Ten of Cups is the rainbow over a happy home — lasting joy, love, and belonging.

name: Page of Cups
upright: A tender message or creative spark. Follow your imagination and open heart.
reversed: Emotional immaturity, blocked creativity, or letting fantasy rule.
general: Page of Cups is the dreamy messenger — intuitive, creative, and emotionally open.

name: Knight of Cups
upright: A romantic, charming offer arrives. Follow your heart with grace and sincerity.
reversed: Emotional dishonesty, moodiness, or chasing an impossible dream.
general: Knight of Cups rides in on romance — an idealistic heart pursuing love and dreams.

name: Queen of Cups
upright: Deeply intuitive and compassionate. Hold space for feelings — yours and others'.
reversed: Emotional overwhelm, codependency, or ignoring your own needs.
general: Queen of Cups is the compassionate listener — wisdom carried in the heart.

name: King of Cups
upright: Emotions are felt yet mastered. Lead with calm compassion and diplomatic grace.
reversed: Emotional suppression, moodiness, or manipulation disguised as care.
general: King of Cups rules the tides within — emotional mastery, maturity, and steady compassion.

name: Ace of Swords
upright: A sharp moment of clarity. Truth cuts through confusion — speak it with confidence.
reversed: Muddled thinking, miscommunication, or harsh words that wound.
general: Ace of Swords is the blade of truth — clarity, insight, and decisive mental force.

name: Two of Swords
upright: A difficult choice you are avoiding. Lower the blindfold and decide.
reversed: Reaching clarity, breaking the deadlock, or indecision finally resolving.
general: Two of Swords stands at an impasse — choosing between options while refusing to see.

name: Three of Swords
upright: A piercing emotional wound. Let the pain pass through so healing can begin.
reversed: Recovery, forgiveness, or the first steps out of heartache.
general: Three of Swords is the pierced heart — sorrow, honesty, and the road back to healing.

name: Four of Swords
upright: Rest is essential. Step back, recharge, and restore your mind before the next move.
reversed: Restlessness, burnout, or refusing to pause when the body asks for rest.
general: Four of Swords lays down the blade — a needed retreat and restoration of energy.

name: Five of Swords
upright: A hollow victory — winning at a price. Consider whether the conflict is worth it.
reversed: Stepping back from conflict, reconciliation, or releasing the need to win.
general: Five of Swords is a pyrrhic victory — choose your battles, some wins cost too much.

name: Six of Swords
upright: Sailing toward smoother waters. Leave the turbulence behind and move forward.
reversed: Stuck in the past, resistance to moving on, or a transition that lingers.
general: Six of Swords crosses the water — a journey from difficulty toward peace.

name: Seven of Swords
upright: A strategy of stealth — or someone taking what is not theirs. Proceed with care.
reversed: Exposure, coming clean, or releasing the need to be sneaky.
general: Seven of Swords is the quiet escape — strategy, caution, and the shadow of deception.

name: Eight of Swords
upright: You feel trapped, yet the cage is partly of your own making. Shift your view.
reversed: Breaking free, releasing self-doubt, or seeing the door that was always open.
general: Eight of Swords is the blindfolded prisoner — limits that are mostly in the mind.

name: Nine of Swords
upright: Sleepless worry and fear. The mind amplifies what the heart fears — seek support.
reversed: Relief, releasing anxiety, or learning that thoughts are not facts.
general: Nine of Swords sits awake with fear — anxiety that eases once it is voiced.

name: Ten of Swords
upright: A painful ending — the lowest point. Only one direction from here: upward.
reversed: Recovery, refusing defeat, or finally closing a painful chapter.
general: Ten of Swords is the final blow — an ending that frees you to rise again.

name: Page of Swords
upright: Sharp curiosity and quick ideas. Ask questions and gather information.
reversed: Scattered thoughts, gossip, or jumping to conclusions.
general: Page of Swords is the alert thinker — curiosity, observation, and nimble wit.

name: Knight of Swords
upright: Fast-moving determination. Cut through obstacles with clarity and conviction.
reversed: Rushing, aggression, or hasty words that cut too deep.
general: Knight of Swords charges with purpose — decisive, quick, and relentless.

name: Queen of Swords
upright: Clear-eyed and independent. Speak the truth kindly and honor your boundaries.
reversed: Coldness, bitterness, or using sharp words as a shield.
general: Queen of Swords sees through illusion — honest, perceptive, and self-reliant.

name: King of Swords
upright: Decisions made with logic and fairness. Lead with intellect and clear principles.
reversed: Rigid judgment, misuse of power, or coldness overriding empathy.
general: King of Swords is the arbiter of truth — intellect, authority, and impartial reason.

name: Ace of Pentacles
upright: A tangible opportunity takes root. Plant it well and let it grow.
reversed: Missed opportunity, poor planning, or money that slips through fingers.
general: Ace of Pentacles is a seed of prosperity — a real, grounded chance to build on.

name: Two of Pentacles
upright: Juggling multiple priorities. Stay flexible and keep the balls in the air.
reversed: Overcommitted, off-balance, or dropping one ball too many.
general: Two of Pentacles juggles gracefully — flexibility and balance amid competing demands.

name: Three of Pentacles
upright: Skilled collaboration builds something lasting. Your work is recognized.
reversed: Lack of teamwork, poor quality, or ego blocking group progress.
general: Three of Pentacles is the craftsman's guild — teamwork, skill, and recognition.

name: Four of Pentacles
upright: Security through discipline. Protect resources, but do not cling too tightly.
reversed: Financial release, letting go of control, or hoarding born of fear.
general: Four of Pentacles clings to what is owned — stability, or the fear beneath it.

name: Five of Pentacles
upright: Times of lack and isolation. Yet help and warmth stand near the door.
reversed: Recovery, relief, or accepting the help that was always offered.
general: Five of Pentacles walks in winter — hardship, yet the doorway to support is open.

name: Six of Pentacles
upright: A fair exchange of giving and receiving. Share resources with an open hand.
reversed: Inequality, strings attached, or imbalance in how much you give and take.
general: Six of Pentacles balances the scales — generosity, gratitude, and fair exchange.

name: Seven of Pentacles
upright: Growth takes patience. Review progress and decide where to invest next.
reversed: Impatience, wasted effort, or projects that never seem to bear fruit.
general: Seven of Pentacles surveys the harvest — patient tending and honest evaluation.

name: Eight of Pentacles
upright: Hard work and practice refine your craft. Dedication leads to mastery.
reversed: Perfectionism, burnout, or lack of focus on the details.
general: Eight of Pentacles works at the bench — diligence, skill-building, and craft.

name: Nine of Pentacles
upright: Comfort and independence, earned through your own effort. Enjoy the garden you grew.
reversed: Dependence, overspending, or feeling unworthy of what you have.
general: Nine of Pentacles is the woman in the vineyard — self-reliant elegance and abundance.

name: Ten of Pentacles
upright: Generations of stability and legacy. Build wealth that outlasts you.
reversed: Family conflict over money, instability, or tradition that stifles.
general: Ten of Pentacles is the ancestral estate — enduring wealth, legacy, and belonging.

name: Page of Pentacles
upright: A promising new project or lesson. Study hard and plant early seeds.
reversed: Lack of discipline, procrastination, or dreams without a plan.
general: Page of Pentacles is the eager student — ambition, learning, and grounded beginnings.

name: Knight of Pentacles
upright: Slow and steady wins. Reliability and patience build a solid foundation.
reversed: Stuck in routine, boredom, or stubborn refusal to change course.
general: Knight of Pentacles plods with purpose — steady, patient, and dependable.

name: Queen of Pentacles
upright: Practical and nurturing. Create comfort and security with grounded care.
reversed: Neglecting practical needs, overwork, or relying too heavily on material things.
general: Queen of Pentacles tends hearth and harvest — practical abundance and nurturing care.

name: King of Pentacles
upright: Wealth built through discipline and leadership. Provide security for those around you.
reversed: Materialism, stubbornness, or wealth that becomes a cage.
general: King of Pentacles is the steadfast provider — prosperity, security, and grounded leadership.
